title.en: The Home Does Not Have to Match the Weather

selection.principle: Keep indoor purpose clear while outdoor conditions change.

recipes.targetGuidance: Use the requested rooms and preserve task areas.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Keep a stable central layer and tune the supporting layer.

invariants: Do not map weather literally to a color.
Keep unrelated rooms untouched.

explanation.headline: 室内不必复制户外
explanation.reason: 用清晰层次保持房间用途，天气只影响节奏和层次。
explanation.claimBoundary: 这是视觉舒适建议，不是天气或健康判断。

title.en: Rain Has More Than One Mood

selection.principle: Use rain transitions and time of day to choose pace, not a literal rain color.

recipes.targetGuidance: Focus on the rooms named by the user; use a stable fallback for unknown rain state.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Adjust contrast and peripheral support before changing temperature.

invariants: Use the precipitation transition when available.
Never claim the rain reveals a human mood.

explanation.headline: 让雨天有层次
explanation.reason: 同样是雨天，时间和变化速度可以支持不同的空间层次。
explanation.claimBoundary: 氛围描述不代表情绪识别。

selection.principle: Keep a noon room from collapsing into a flat, dim field.

recipes.targetGuidance: Keep a clear work or task area and use peripheral depth in the selected room.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Give the task plane a clear anchor and keep the perimeter supportive.

invariants: Do not use a timer as evidence of work or reading.
Keep the task area readable.

explanation.headline: 把阴天中午撑起来
explanation.reason: 用空间层次保留室内深度，而不是把所有灯调成同一亮度。
explanation.claimBoundary: 清晰度建议不等于工作状态推断。

selection.principle: Make a pre-sunrise transition gentle and local-time correct.

recipes.targetGuidance: Use only the requested rooms and honor the host trigger window.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Start with a restrained perimeter and keep the center clear.

invariants: Use the configured IANA timezone.
Do not infer wake or sleep from the schedule.

explanation.headline: 在日出前慢慢过渡
explanation.reason: 用本地日出时间安排温和的层次变化。
explanation.claimBoundary: 定时不代表知道用户是否醒着。

selection.principle: Bridge an early sunset without making the whole room heavy.

recipes.targetGuidance: Use the selected areas and preserve any protected task room.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Retain a readable center and add quiet perimeter support.

invariants: Do not imply the user has finished work.
Keep protected targets unchanged.

explanation.headline: 给早日落留一段过渡
explanation.reason: 日落提前时，用层次连接室外和室内的明暗变化。
explanation.claimBoundary: 时间上下文不代表用户活动状态。

selection.principle: Make a warm evening feel visually open without pretending light changes air temperature.

recipes.targetGuidance: Open only the selected rooms; target lights may turn on or off to create a lighter distribution.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Keep task areas clear and reduce dense visual weight.

invariants: Require fresh temperature or apparent temperature for automatic selection.
State that light does not cool air.
Keep saturation and dense warm coverage restrained.

explanation.headline: 炎热夜晚的轻光
explanation.reason: 减少视觉密度，保留清晰的活动区域，让空间更轻。
explanation.claimBoundary: 灯光不会降低空气温度。

p0Contract.baseline: Use the current target state and the explicit threshold or default host threshold.
p0Contract.strategy: Use lighter spatial distribution, low saturation, moderate contrast, clear task areas, and target-scope power flexibility.
p0Contract.fallback: Stale heat data skips the automatic branch; a manual request can preview with the unknown called out.
p0Contract.rollback: Restore only from a trustworthy pre-change snapshot through a new explicit control.

title.zh-CN: 寒冷夜晚，不必全屋发黄

selection.principle: Place warmth around the room while retaining central clarity and depth.

recipes.targetGuidance: Use peripheral and central roles inside the selected rooms; target lights may turn on or off to establish hierarchy.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Keep the center readable and put restrained warmth at the perimeter.

invariants: Require fresh temperature or apparent temperature for automatic selection.
Never make the whole home dim and uniformly warm.
Retain visible spatial depth and task readability.

explanation.headline: 温暖，但不压暗空间
explanation.reason: 把温暖放到边缘，中心仍保持清晰和有层次。
explanation.claimBoundary: 视觉温暖不等于室内升温。

p0Contract.baseline: Use the current target state and an explicit cold threshold or default host threshold.
p0Contract.strategy: Use peripheral warmth, natural central clarity, visible depth, restrained saturation, and a slower supported transition.
p0Contract.fallback: Stale cold data uses a neutral clear plan rather than a whole-home warm dim state.
p0Contract.rollback: Restore only from a trustworthy pre-change snapshot through a new explicit control.

selection.principle: Offer a stable low-stimulus arrangement when an official alert is active.

recipes.targetGuidance: Keep the selected safe-feeling visual scope; do not make emergency or occupancy claims.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Use a stable center and reduce unnecessary contrast changes.

invariants: Use only a region-appropriate authority source.
This is not an emergency warning or safety system.

explanation.headline: 让空间保持安静稳定
explanation.reason: 官方警报仍有效时，减少不必要的视觉变化。
explanation.claimBoundary: 灯光不替代官方预警或安全措施。

selection.principle: Use a clearing transition to recover openness without a dramatic reset.

recipes.targetGuidance: Reopen only the selected room layers and preserve protected areas.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Move from focused support toward balanced depth.

invariants: Use a verified rain-to-clear transition.
Do not infer a change in human mood.

explanation.headline: 雨停后把空间打开
explanation.reason: 利用降水转折恢复空间的通透层次。
explanation.claimBoundary: 天气转折不代表情绪转折。

selection.principle: Create a one-time demonstration of the day structure when the user asks for it.

recipes.targetGuidance: Use a bounded one-time target scope; never turn the demonstration into an implicit schedule.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Compose a short sequence from daylight structure and the user's chosen emphasis.

invariants: Require an explicit one-time demonstration request.
Do not persist a schedule without a separate request.

explanation.headline: 把今天的结构写成光
explanation.reason: 把日照趋势和用户选择组合成一次短暂的灯光表达。
explanation.claimBoundary: 这是创意演示，不是对人的叙事或预测。

selection.principle: Let a weekend morning expand gently without copying a weekday start.

recipes.targetGuidance: Honor any work-area exclusion and keep target rooms open and comfortable.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Use broad support before a task-focused center.

invariants: Weekend is a calendar fact, not proof of leisure.
Keep excluded work areas unchanged.

explanation.headline: 让周末早晨慢一点
explanation.reason: 周末日历只改变节奏，不替用户安排活动。
explanation.claimBoundary: 周末不代表知道用户是否休息。

title.en: A Celebration That Knows When to Whisper

selection.principle: Let a selected observance become quieter as the day closes.

recipes.targetGuidance: Use the chosen celebration rooms and keep the user's protected areas intact.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Keep a calm center and a restrained celebratory layer.

invariants: Require explicit region and theme selection.
Never invent a cultural meaning from a date alone.

explanation.headline: 庆祝也有轻声时刻
explanation.reason: 把用户选定的庆祝主题放进合适的时间层次。
explanation.claimBoundary: 文化内容来自用户选择和公共日历，不来自情绪推断。

selection.principle: Ease out of the final holiday evening before a workday.

recipes.targetGuidance: Use the existing celebration scope; do not discover new rooms from the calendar.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Reduce contrast gradually while preserving a readable center.

invariants: Require existing celebration context.
A workday calendar fact does not prove a user's schedule.

explanation.headline: 节日慢慢收尾
explanation.reason: 从已存在的庆祝层次平缓退场，保留空间清晰度。
explanation.claimBoundary: 日历只说明日期关系。

selection.principle: Move an approved schedule a little as the daylight changes, without replacing the season wholesale.

recipes.targetGuidance: Change only the Skill-owned host schedule and its declared target scope.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Preserve the baseline hierarchy while moving timing and transition gradually.

invariants: Require a verified baseline and Skill-owned task.
Use IANA timezone and DST rules for every revision.
Never rewrite an ambiguous or unrelated task.

explanation.headline: 季节只轻轻移动一点
explanation.reason: 根据日照变化微调已有节奏，不把整个季节换成另一套场景。
explanation.claimBoundary: 缓移依据是日期和日照，不是对人的状态判断。

p0Contract.baseline: Use an existing Skill-owned host schedule or an explicit approved schedule template, with immutable task ownership and household binding.
p0Contract.strategy: Apply small bounded timing, transition, hierarchy, or warmth-range changes from sunrise, sunset, twilight, daylight trend, and DST; preserve the original concept.
p0Contract.fallback: Missing, stale, drifting, or ambiguous baseline asks for clarification and leaves the task unchanged.
p0Contract.rollback: Restore the stored baseline or previous host revision when the host exposes revision history; lighting restoration remains a separate control.

selection.principle: Mark a first threshold crossing with a restrained spatial change.

recipes.targetGuidance: Use only the explicitly enabled target scope.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Add a peripheral layer while keeping the center clear.

invariants: Require an explicit threshold and prior enablement.
Temperature is context, not a heating instruction.

explanation.headline: 第一晚的轻微变化
explanation.reason: 只在明确启用后，用一次季节阈值变化调整空间边缘。
explanation.claimBoundary: 灯光不会改变室温。

selection.principle: Offer an annual ritual around the local day structure.

recipes.targetGuidance: Keep the annual ritual local to the selected targets.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Use a clear center with a quiet, slightly slower perimeter.

invariants: Require explicit annual ritual enablement.
Allow unknown when solstice data is unavailable.

explanation.headline: 给最长的夜晚一个节奏
explanation.reason: 用本地日照长度做一次明确开启的年度仪式。
explanation.claimBoundary: 这是日历仪式，不是对人的状态推断。

selection.principle: Translate an explicit comfort request into a small, explainable adjustment.

recipes.targetGuidance: Start from the live state and change only the requested targets.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Preserve the user's existing hierarchy and adjust one or two dimensions.

invariants: Require an explicit comfort request.
Do not convert a vague request into a medical claim.

explanation.headline: 从当前状态开始调整
explanation.reason: 舒适取决于用户此刻明确说出的目标和已有层次。
explanation.claimBoundary: 舒适是视觉体验，不是医疗结论。

selection.principle: Balance a gray outdoor context with indoor purpose instead of using a literal sky color.

recipes.targetGuidance: Use the user's target rooms and keep task surfaces readable.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Increase indoor clarity through distribution and contrast, not sky imitation.

invariants: Never use literal weather-to-color mapping.
Keep the plan useful when cloud data is stale.

explanation.headline: 不把天空搬进房间
explanation.reason: 用室内层次回应阴暗环境，而不是复制户外颜色。
explanation.claimBoundary: 天气只提供环境结构。

title.zh-CN: 外面下雨，里面保持清晰

selection.principle: Keep a weekday room clear during rain without inferring work or presence.

recipes.targetGuidance: Keep the declared clear area readable and leave protected rooms untouched.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Anchor a clear task layer and keep rain-related contrast changes subtle.

invariants: Weekday and rain do not prove anyone is working.
Honor protected areas.

explanation.headline: 雨天里保持室内清晰
explanation.reason: 为用户指定的区域保留稳定层次，不替用户安排工作。
explanation.claimBoundary: 日历和雨势不代表占用状态。

selection.principle: Answer a warm-but-light request with restrained warmth and open distribution.

recipes.targetGuidance: Place the requested feeling in the selected room layers; keep the center usable.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Use peripheral support and leave the center visually open.

invariants: Do not make heat claims.
Do not make the whole target uniformly dim or warm.

explanation.headline: 温暖，但保持轻盈
explanation.reason: 温暖放在层次和边缘，避免整间房变得厚重。
explanation.claimBoundary: 视觉温暖不会改变温度。

selection.principle: Use a selected celebration theme with low visual noise.

recipes.targetGuidance: Keep celebration changes within the named rooms and target lights.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Keep the center readable and place a restrained accent layer around it.

invariants: Require explicit theme and scope.
Do not infer cultural meaning from a date alone.

explanation.headline: 把庆祝放轻一点
explanation.reason: 保留庆祝的层次，同时让空间保持安静和可用。
explanation.claimBoundary: 庆祝主题由用户选择。

title.en: Let the Weekend Take the Room Back

selection.principle: Release a declared work-area boundary on a weekend morning without guessing occupation.

recipes.targetGuidance: Only change the selected rooms and honor any declared work-area exclusion.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Broaden the selected room while leaving excluded areas unchanged.

invariants: Weekend does not prove absence or leisure.
Never expand the target from the calendar.

explanation.headline: 把空间还给周末
explanation.reason: 根据用户声明的范围放开层次，不根据日期猜测房间是否有人。
explanation.claimBoundary: 这是范围规则，不是占用检测。

title.zh-CN: 一条规则，不是一幕场景

selection.principle: Maintain a small repeatable rule while allowing the current room to remain itself.

recipes.targetGuidance: Encode a bounded rule for the named scope rather than replacing the entire room with a scene.

lightingStrategy.hierarchy: Adjust only the layer named by the objective and preserve the rest.

invariants: Keep the rule limited to the declared target scope.
Do not create a persistent cloud automation by default.
Never hide an unrelated room change inside a rule.

explanation.headline: 让规则服务于空间
explanation.reason: 用一条小规则回应明确目标，而不是把房间替换成预设场景。
explanation.claimBoundary: 规则依据公开事实和用户原则，不依据人的隐私状态。
